verdict.rationale: telli's changelog documents a Scheduled trigger that runs workflows automatically on a recurring schedule, with a configurable interval and start time and no call event needed. The schedule-call API endpoint is a one-off action, not a recurring schedule, so it adds no credit here. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on scheduled triggers (interval options, timezone, failure handling, management via API), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Workflows can now run automatically on a recurring schedule. Add a Scheduled trigger, choose the interval and start time, and let the workflow run without a call event.
